mark.16.p1.b2.text: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices

mark.16.p1.b3.text: So they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.

mark.16.p2.b1.text: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.

mark.16.p2.b2.text: Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?

mark.16.p2.b3.text: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.

mark.16.p3.b2.text: They saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

mark.16.p3.b3.text: Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here!

mark.16.p3.b4.text: See the place where they put Him.

mark.16.p4.b1.text: But go, tell His disciples and Peter,

mark.16.p4.b2.text: He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.

mark.16.p4.b3.text: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered.

mark.16.p4.b4.text: And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.

mark.16.p5.b1.text: Early on the first day of the week,

mark.16.p5.b2.text: After Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene,

mark.16.p5.b3.text: She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.

mark.16.p5.b4.text: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it.

mark.16.p6.b1.text: After this, … two of them as they walked along in the country.

mark.16.p6.b2.text: Jesus appeared in a different form

mark.16.p6.b3.text: And they went back and reported it to the rest,

mark.16.p6.b4.text: But they did not believe them either.

mark.16.p7.b3.text: And rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart,

mark.16.p7.b4.text: Because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.

mark.16.p8.b1.text: Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.

mark.16.p8.b2.text: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.

mark.16.p8.b3.text: And these signs will accompany those who believe:

mark.16.p8.b4.text: They will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.

mark.16.p9.b1.text: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them,

mark.16.p9.b2.text: He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

mark.16.p9.b3.text: And they went out and preached everywhere,

mark.16.p9.b4.text: And the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
